g.text: Model: Voyager X-band link — 21.3 W, 3.66 m antenna, coded Eb/N0 ≈ 2.5 dB plus 3 dB margin.
At Jupiter and Saturn the DSN dishes were 64 m; for Uranus and Neptune they were enlarged and arrayed with other radio telescopes.
